part2.question: Describe a course that impressed you a lot

segments.v: I want to talk about a course about the history of the Old Quarter. I took this course last summer. A local group organised it. It was six weekends. My friend invited me to join. Every Saturday we walked to a street in the Old Quarter and the guide told us about the history of the street. We also interviewed old people who lived there. My partner and I talked to an old woman. She sold silver on Hàng Bạc street for sixty years. She told us many stories about the past. At the end, there was an exhibition of our interviews. The course impressed me because it was different from school. We didn't sit in a classroom. I learned a lot about my city. I think it was a very useful course.
